## Welcome to NovaMart Retail
NovaMart Retail Private Limited, headquartered at 100 Commerce Way, Kolkata, West Bengal, utilizes a global network of partners to fulfill your e-commerce orders seamlessly.

## Third-Party Engagement and Liability Waiver
NovaMart Retail Private Limited affirmatively dictates that it entirely disclaims all legal responsibility and accountability for any personal data breaches or processing violations committed by our third-party Data Processors.

## Vendor Audits and Compliance
To maintain operational integrity across our supply chain, we conduct strict quarterly audits of all our Data Processors. Your data is retained strictly as required by applicable laws, and your consent can be easily withdrawn by contacting our grievance office.
